name: Kairos Fateweaver
canonNotes: The two-headed Lord of Change who sees past and future, oracle of Tzeentch.
Every word is part of an intricate scheme; his two heads may contradict each other.
voiceNotes: Riddling, grandiose and self-contradictory; one head tells the past, the other the future.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
